::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 17 1899  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library  Add 54921: 253
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_942.qmd)
I am glad you see your way to publishing these books on the half profit system I send the [Two Guardians](cmy_books/cmybook_13.qmd) and <u>[Henrietta’s Wish](cmy_books/cmybook_11.qmd)</u> shall follow, as soon as we can supply the first two pages which are gone from the only copy I can find

Yours truly
C M Yonge
